issues.claim: Конвейер фильтров выполняется только для действий контроллеров (у Razor Pages свои page-фильтры). / The filter pipeline runs only for controller actions (Razor Pages have their own page filters).
issues.problem: Slightly loose. Razor Pages also run the shared filter pipeline (authorization, resource, exception and result filters) and add page filters. Only MVC action filters are controller-specific. The conclusion that action filters are MVC-only is still correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Write: "Action-фильтры выполняются только для действий контроллеров (у Razor Pages свои page-фильтры, у Minimal API - endpoint-фильтры)" and mirror it in EN: "Action filters run only for controller actions (Razor Pages have page filters, Minimal APIs have endpoint filters)".

issues.problem: Latin word in Russian prose (parity warning).

issues.claim: Условия: HTTPS-эндпоинты с сертификатом, фильтрация хостов (`AllowedHosts`) ... / a service template with `UseForwardedHeaders` and `KnownProxies` (or with `AllowedHosts`, limits and HTTPS for the no-proxy option)
issues.problem: Host filtering is presented as a requirement only for the no-proxy variant. The cited when-to-use-a-reverse-proxy page warns explicitly: "Hosting in a reverse proxy configuration requires host filtering." The proxy-load-balancer page also describes ForwardedHeadersOptions.AllowedHosts for X-Forwarded-Host. A candidate would conclude that a proxy removes the need for host filtering. The "cost of a proxy" section does not mention it.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a bullet under "Цена прокси" / "The cost of a proxy": "Фильтрация хостов обязательна и за прокси: настройте `AllowedHosts` (и `ForwardedHeadersOptions.AllowedHosts`, если приложение доверяет `X-Forwarded-Host`)." / "Host filtering is still required behind a proxy: configure `AllowedHosts` (and `ForwardedHeadersOptions.AllowedHosts` if the app trusts `X-Forwarded-Host`)." Update step 3 of "What the lead does" so the template includes `AllowedHosts` in both variants.

issues.claim: потому что по умолчанию доверяется только loopback / because by default only loopback is trusted
issues.problem: True for the default ForwardedHeadersOptions. The proxy-load-balancer page also describes the ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED environment variable, commonly set in containers, which turns the middleware on and changes the trust assumptions. It is not mentioned. In .NET 10, `KnownProxies` alone also does not cover proxies with variable IPs, which need `KnownIPNetworks`.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a short clause: "(в контейнерах с ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true проверьте границы доверия; для динамических адресов используйте `KnownIPNetworks`)" and the EN equivalent.
